# `<util/spawn.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Starting programs: load a ZXF or ELF32 image into a new space and run it.

```c
#include <util/spawn.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="spawn_prio_inherit"></a>`SPAWN_PRIO_INHERIT` | `(-1)` | [SpawnAttr](#spawnattr) value meaning "keep what the new task inherits from the caller". |

## Structures

### `SpawnAttr` { #spawnattr }

Scheduling settings for a new program.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `prio` | `int32_t` | Base priority, or SPAWN_PRIO_INHERIT. |
| `max_prio` | `int32_t` | Maximum priority, or SPAWN_PRIO_INHERIT. |

## Functions

### `SpawnProcess` { #spawnprocess }

```c
Err SpawnProcess(const void *image, size_t size, const char *name, const char *argbuf, size_t argbuf_len, uint32_t argc, Spid *out_pid, Handle *out_task);
```

Starts a program from an image in memory.

Detects ZXF or ELF32 by its magic, creates a space and a task, maps the load segments, lays out argv on a fresh stack, gives the new space the name-service port in its handle slot 0, and starts the task with r0 = argc and r1 = argv.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `image` | in | Image bytes, 4-byte aligned. |
| `size` | in | Image size in bytes. |
| `name` | in | Name for the new space; truncated to 31 characters. |
| `argbuf` | in | argv strings back to back, each NUL-terminated ("a\0b\0"), or NULL. |
| `argbuf_len` | in | Length of `argbuf` including the NULs, or 0. |
| `argc` | in | Number of strings in `argbuf`, or 0. |
| `out_pid` | out | Receives the new space's handle; may be NULL. |
| `out_task` | out | Receives the new task's handle; may be NULL. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_MALFORMED`](../../errors.md#err_malformed) | The image is neither a valid ZXF nor a valid ARM ELF32 executable. |
| [`ERR_OVERFLOW`](../../errors.md#err_overflow) | The image has more than 8 load segments. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../../errors.md#err_badarg) | `argc` and `argbuf` disagree, or argv needs more than 16 KiB. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../../errors.md#err_nomem) | Out of memory. |

### `SpawnProcessAttr` { #spawnprocessattr }

```c
Err SpawnProcessAttr(const void *image, size_t size, const char *name, const char *argbuf, size_t argbuf_len, uint32_t argc, const SpawnAttr *attr, Spid *out_pid, Handle *out_task);
```

SpawnProcess() with scheduling settings.

`prio` must not exceed `max_prio`, and neither may exceed the caller's own maximum priority.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `image` | in | Image bytes, 4-byte aligned. |
| `size` | in | Image size in bytes. |
| `name` | in | Name for the new space. |
| `argbuf` | in | argv strings back to back, or NULL. |
| `argbuf_len` | in | Length of `argbuf`, or 0. |
| `argc` | in | Number of strings in `argbuf`, or 0. |
| `attr` | in | Scheduling settings, or NULL to inherit both. |
| `out_pid` | out | Receives the new space's handle; may be NULL. |
| `out_task` | out | Receives the new task's handle; may be NULL. |

**Returns:** As SpawnProcess(); also ERR_BADARG if prio is above max_prio, or ERR_NOPERM if either is above the caller's maximum.

### `SpawnProcessObj` { #spawnprocessobj }

```c
Err SpawnProcessObj(Handle image_obj, size_t size, const char *name, const char *argbuf, size_t argbuf_len, uint32_t argc, Spid *out_pid, Handle *out_task);
```

SpawnProcess() from an image held in a memory object, e.g.

read there by FsdReadObj().

Read-only segments whose file offset is page-aligned are mapped straight from the object, without copying; the rest is copied. The caller keeps `image_obj` and may close it afterwards: the new program's mappings hold their own references.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `image_obj` | in | Memory object holding the image. |
| `size` | in | Image size in bytes. |
| `name` | in | Name for the new space. |
| `argbuf` | in | argv strings back to back, or NULL. |
| `argbuf_len` | in | Length of `argbuf`, or 0. |
| `argc` | in | Number of strings in `argbuf`, or 0. |
| `out_pid` | out | Receives the new space's handle; may be NULL. |
| `out_task` | out | Receives the new task's handle; may be NULL. |

**Returns:** As SpawnProcess(), or the error from mapping `image_obj`.
